name: Claude Pet
author: Mar
description: Clawd, a tiny Claude Code companion in the bar and on your desktop. Reads with a magnifier, builds with a wrench, waits at the laptop when Claude needs you, wears headphones while your music plays and naps otherwise. Forked from OmaPets.

barWidget.description: Clawd reacts to what Claude Code is doing. Click for moves and options.

schema.label: Animation speed
schema.description: Lower is calmer. 1.0 is already slower than the original GIFs.

schema.label: Animate
schema.description: Off shows one still frame and runs no timer.

schema.label: Walk on desktop
schema.description: Clawd strolls along the bottom of the screen while Claude is idle.

schema.label: Pin in place
schema.description: Keep the desktop Clawd still. Right-click it to toggle.

schema.label: Bar
schema.description: Single: one Clawd with a badge. Agents: one Clawd per Claude Code session.

schema.label: Badge
schema.description: On the single Clawd: how many agents are working or waiting on you (from two up).
